title: Bottomless Buckets
description: Datapack that adds craftable bottomless water and lava buckets, inspired by the ones in Terraria
body:
Adds the bottomless water and lava buckets, similar to the items from Terraria. 

Functions how you would expect; I guarantee you won't see the bottom!

## Recipes
### Bottomless Water Bucket
![Bottomless water bucket recipe. Three diamonds in the top row, a water bucket in the center, one obsidian to the left and right of the water bucket, and a heart of the sea beneath the bucket.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72ce139fede1fb7ce654bd44c0c1bafb9a47652a.png)
### Bottomless Lava Bucket
![Bottomless lava bucket recipe. Three diamonds in the top row, a lava bucket in the center, a glowstone block below the lava bucket, and obsidian in each of the remaining slots.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/807ac3504d3002e83915f9140db087f39f237c54.png)

If recipes aren't showing up for someone, just run `/function bottomless:give_recipes`. If you want to remove the recipes, go into `/bottomless_buckets_vX.X/data/bottomless/` and delete the `recipe` folder, alongside the `give_recipes.mcfunction` and `take_recipes.mcfunction` files in the `/bottomless_buckets_vX.X/data/bottomless/functions` folder.


There's a version that only supports servers with the EssentialsX plugin enabled, but that will not work on vanilla servers. You may find that datapack [here](https://modrinth.com/project/bottomless-buckets-essentialsx). Servers running paper or other plugin-able platforms without EssentialsX haven't been tested with any datapack, and may break depending on other untested plugins.

This was originally made for an SMP I'm on, so future and/or previous supported Minecraft versions this aren't guaranteed. DM me on Discord @HaHAjax for issues or feature requests for now, I might setup an actual issue tracker later.

Fully gen-ai free!
